investigation.method: manual review of the published website URL, basic host behaviour, and a quick follow-up search/NHS-profile cross-check for alternate domains

headline: The published website URL for Dr Y Loomba and Partner is effectively broken as a patient-facing site. The host serves an Apache placeholder page rather than a usable practice website, so this practice currently looks like a 'no usable digital front door visible at the published URL' case.

live_stack.label: Published website endpoint
evidence: Fetching the published website URL returns a generic It works! Apache httpd page.
Accessing the www hostname also triggers hostname/certificate mismatch issues during normal verification.

current_routes.label: Published website URL
notes: No live appointment, prescription, complaints or online-service routes could be investigated from the published URL because it does not expose an actual practice site.

current_routes.label: Alternate-domain follow-up
notes: A quick search/NHS-profile cross-check did not surface a clearly live replacement practice website during this pass.
That means the main signal here is still a broken published domain, not just a server rejecting one request pattern.

complaints_and_feedback.headline: No usable complaints route was available from the published website URL during this pass.

items.label: Website-level complaints route
notes: No practice complaints page or contact structure could be reviewed because the host serves only a placeholder page.

stale_or_conflicting_signals.label: Certificate and host mismatch
notes: Normal HTTPS verification for the published www hostname fails because the certificate does not match that hostname.

stale_or_conflicting_signals.label: Placeholder instead of practice website
notes: The public URL appears to point to a misconfigured or abandoned web host rather than an active practice site.

probably_true: The published website URL is not currently functioning as a practice website.
No clearly live replacement website was identified during a quick search follow-up.
needs_follow_up: Whether the practice now uses a different live domain that is not reflected in the current listing data.
Whether patients are being pushed primarily toward phone and NHS profile contact because the website is broken.
